summary: An on/off switch, like a light switch, used to turn a setting on or off.
description: A simple toggle switch used to switch between two states (on/off), with an optional label and description.

attributes.name: pressed
attributes.description: Whether or not the element is pressed (on).

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Whether or not the element is disabled.

attributes.name: ariaLabel
attributes.description: The aria-label text when there is no visible label.

attributes.name: ariaDescription
attributes.description: The aria-description text when there is no visible description.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title attribute, mapped onto the inner button.

slots.name: support-link
slots.description: Used to append a moz-support-link to the description.

events.name: toggle
events.description: Custom event (bubbles, composed) indicating that the toggle's pressed state has changed.
